task.title: Establish the authoritative supervisor v2 specification and delta task store

scope.owned_layer: Authoritative task-state V2 persistence: compact current head, append-only state deltas, V1 archive migration and offline integrity verification, task-store architecture specification, and runtime caller migration to explicit observational reads.
scope.not_changing: Supervisor scheduling policy, task lifecycle policy, fleet routing, provider policy, live configuration, canonical live state, service processes, or deployment.

architecture.write_order: validate head and tail -> append/fsync delta -> atomically replace/fsync head
architecture.recovery: replay only the V2 delta tail after head.delta_offset; reject incomplete or corrupt tails
architecture.archive: V1 bytes are moved once to a read-only sibling archive with byte length, final sequence, journal SHA-256 and projected-state SHA-256 bound into V2 genesis/head identity. Interrupted-migration resume and offline full-chain verification require the sequence-1 V2 transition to materialize the exact frozen projected-state digest.
architecture.hot_path: No V1 archive read, V1 replay, mmap, prefix hash, checkpoint sidecar, or forced full replay is available to normal load or mutation paths.
architecture.offline_only: verify_full_chain() and scripts/verify_task_state_store.py validate every V2 delta and frozen V1 archive.

removed_hot_path: V1 full-board state on every event
full-journal mmap, hash, replay, and checkpoint cache
full-journal append readback and automatic V1 fallback
deletion_and_caller_report.caller_boundary: All remaining production callers use load_snapshot(), snapshot_transaction(), or append_state_commit(); read-only callers select the explicit observational keyword. load_events() and project_latest_state() are offline audit compatibility readers only.

acceptance_evidence.delta_not_full_state: A 1,200-task board status change serializes one tasks[index].status set delta, while materializing or archiving one row serializes one indexed insert or remove; no transition persists a state field.
acceptance_evidence.constant_hot_read_cost: Synthetic multi-megabyte V1 archive migration test performs repeated load_snapshot calls with archive parsing patched to fail; every hot read succeeds. The dispatcher scale benchmark clones only the V2 event log, compact head, and lock, then proves V2 head/tail consistency without a checkpoint sidecar.
acceptance_evidence.streamed_archive_migration_memory: A streaming fixture of 260 full-board revisions across 1,100 tasks is at least 16 MiB. The legacy reader regression forbids _read_regular_bytes, records only 64 KiB os.read calls, and requires traced allocation below 8 MiB, below one quarter of journal bytes, and below 16 times the largest record plus 4 MiB. The reader incrementally computes exact journal bytes and SHA-256 while retaining only the unfinished record and newest projected state. Production preflight budget is 64 MiB plus 16R + 4S, where R is the largest record and S is the largest decoded state footprint; it is independent of journal length J.
failure_boundaries: stale expected sequence/head CAS is rejected
nonterminal task loss is rejected before append
crash after fsynced delta and before head replacement recovers exactly the tail, and offline full-chain verification validates that durable tail
tampered frozen archive fails offline verification
resume after an archive rename reasserts read-only archive permissions before continuing
a resumed archive plus manifest must match byte length, final sequence, journal SHA and projected-state SHA before genesis can be written
an internally rehashed V2 sequence-1 transition that materializes a state other than the frozen archive projection is rejected by both interrupted-migration resume and offline full-chain verification
the dispatcher scale benchmark accepts a synthetic V2 store with a compact head and no checkpoint sidecar
nonempty V1 journal with no V2 head fails migration-required instead of falling back

rollout.source_delivery: Merge the reviewed task PR into dev. A separately governed runtime promotion performs the migration dry-run, migration, offline verification, and V2 canary.
rollout.rollback: Stop writers, preserve V2 head/deltas/manifest/archive, verify them offline, and use an explicit separately named V1 recovery journal only if an authorized older-binary rollback is required. No automatic V1 fallback exists.

review.protocol: Review this committed manifest, all changed paths, and the exact task-branch head that contains this manifest. Confirm candidate source commit a1ffde13394e20c0d206e30246adfda11ab974d1 replaces legacy full-payload/splitlines validation with O_NOFOLLOW 64 KiB streaming reads, incremental byte/SHA accounting, complete-record and V1 chain/state validation, and that dry-run, initial migration, resume, and offline verification all invoke the same bounded reader. Confirm an internally rehashed sequence-1 V2 delta cannot diverge from archive_identity.projected_state_sha256 during resume or offline full-chain verification, while normal reads remain archive-free. Confirm the scale benchmark clones V2 log/head/lock evidence only and its synthetic V2 test has no checkpoint sidecar. Inspect the 16 MiB+ streaming regression and the documented 64 MiB + 16R + 4S migration budget. Bind this same review_file through the governed approve command; any changed PR head requires a new independent review.
